items.source: The prefix spring.ai.ollama.embedding is the property prefix that configures the Ollama embedding model. It includes the Ollama request (advanced) parameters such as the model, keep-alive, and truncate as well as the Ollama model properties.
items.translation: 前缀 `spring.ai.ollama.embedding` 是用于配置 Ollama 嵌入模型的特性前缀。它包括 Ollama 请求（高级）参数，如 `model`、`keep-alive` 和 `truncate`，以及 Ollama 模型属性。

items.source: The remaining options properties are based on the Ollama Valid Parameters and Values and Ollama Types. The default values are based on: Ollama type defaults.
items.translation: 其余的 options 属性基于Ollama 有效参数和值以及Ollama 类型。默认值基于：Ollama 类型默认值。

items.source: At start-time use the OllamaEmbeddingModel(OllamaApi ollamaApi, OllamaEmbeddingOptions options) to configure the default options used for all embedding requests. At run-time you can override the default options, using a OllamaEmbeddingOptions instance as part of your EmbeddingRequest.
items.translation: 在启动时，使用 `OllamaEmbeddingModel(OllamaApi ollamaApi, OllamaEmbeddingOptions options)` 配置所有嵌入请求的默认选项。 在运行时，您可以使用一个 `OllamaEmbeddingOptions` 实例作为您 `EmbeddingRequest` 的一部分来覆盖默认选项。

items.source: Ollama can access, out of the box, all GGUF Hugging Face Embedding models. You can pull any of these models by name: ollama pull hf.co/<username>/<model-repository> or configure the auto-pulling strategy: Auto-pulling Models:
items.translation: Ollama 开箱即可访问所有GGUF Hugging Face嵌入模型。您可以通过名称拉取这些模型中的任何一个：ollama pull hf.co/<用户名>/<模型仓库>，或配置自动拉取策略：自动拉取模型：

items.source: This will create a EmbeddingModel implementation that you can inject into your class. Here is an example of a simple @Controller class that uses the EmbeddingModel implementation.
items.translation: 这将创建一个 `EmbeddingModel` 实现，您可以将其注入到您的类中。 以下是一个使用 `EmbeddingModel` 实现的简单 `@Controller` 类的示例。

items.source: With Ollama you can run various AI Models locally and generate embeddings from them. An embedding is a vector (list) of floating point numbers. The distance between two vectors measures their relatedness. Small distances suggest high relatedness and large distances suggest low relatedness.
items.translation: 使用 Ollama，您可以在本地运行各种 AI 模型 并从中生成嵌入向量。 嵌入向量是一个浮点数列表（向量）。 两个向量之间的距离衡量了它们的相关性。 较小的距离表示高度相关，较大的距离表示相关性较低。

items.source: The OllamaEmbeddingModel implementation leverages the Ollama Embeddings API endpoint.
items.translation: OllamaEmbeddingModel 实现利用了 Ollama嵌入 API端点。

items.source: Spring AI provides Spring Boot auto-configuration for the Ollama Embedding Model. To enable it add the following dependency to your Maven pom.xml or Gradle build.gradle build files:
items.translation: Spring AI 为 Ollama 嵌入模型提供了 Spring Boot 自动配置功能。 要启用该功能，请在您的 Maven `pom.xml` 或 Gradle `build.gradle` 构建文件中添加以下依赖：

items.source: The name of the supported model to use. You can use dedicated Embedding Model types
items.translation: 要使用的支持模型的名称。 您可以使用专用的嵌入模型类型

items.source: always (defined in PullModelStrategy.ALWAYS): Always pull the model, even if it’s already available. Useful to ensure you’re using the latest version of the model.
items.translation: always（在 PullModelStrategy.ALWAYS 中定义）：始终拉取模型，即使它已经可用。这有助于确保您使用的是最新版本的模型。

items.source: when_missing (defined in PullModelStrategy.WHEN_MISSING): Only pull the model if it’s not already available. This may result in using an older version of the model.
items.translation: when_missing（定义于PullModelStrategy.WHEN_MISSING）：仅在模型不可用时才拉取。这可能导致使用较旧版本的模型。

items.source: never (defined in PullModelStrategy.NEVER): Never pull the model automatically.
items.translation: never（在 PullModelStrategy.NEVER 中定义）：从不自动拉取模型。

items.source: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.model: Specifies the Hugging Face GGUF model to use.
items.translation: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.model：指定要使用的Hugging Face GGUF 模型。

items.source: spring.ai.ollama.init.pull-model-strategy=always: (optional) Enables automatic model pulling at startup time. For production, you should pre-download the models to avoid delays: ollama pull hf.co/mixedbread-ai/mxbai-embed-large-v1.
items.translation: spring.ai.ollama.init.pull-model-strategy=always：（可选）启用启动时自动拉取模型。 在生产环境中，建议预先下载模型以避免延迟：ollama pull hf.co/mixedbread-ai/mxbai-embed-large-v1。

items.translation: 在您的本地机器上下载并安装 Ollama。

items.translation: 配置并通过 Testcontainers 运行 Ollama。

items.translation: 您可以从Ollama 模型库中拉取应用程序所需的模型：

items.translation: 您还可以拉取数千个免费的GGUF Hugging Face 模型：

items.source: Alternatively, you can enable the option to download automatically any needed model: Auto-pulling Models.
items.translation: 或者，您可以启用自动下载所需模型的选项：自动拉取模型。

items.source: There has been a significant change in the Spring AI auto-configuration, starter modules' artifact names. Please refer to the upgrade notes for more information.
items.translation: Spring AI 的自动配置中，starter 模块的构件名称已发生重大变更。 有关更多信息，请参阅升级说明。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.ollama is the property prefix to configure the connection to Ollama
items.translation: spring.ai.ollama 前缀是用于配置与 Ollama 连接的属性前缀。

items.source: Here are the properties for initializing the Ollama integration and auto-pulling models.
items.translation: 以下是初始化 Ollama 集成和自动拉取模型的属性。

items.source: Enabling and disabling of the embedding auto-configurations are now configured via top level properties with the prefix spring.ai.model.embedding.
items.translation: 启用和禁用嵌入自动配置现在通过带有前缀spring.ai.model.embedding的顶层属性进行配置。

items.source: The OllamaEmbeddingOptions.java provides the Ollama configurations, such as the model to use, the low level GPU and CPU tuning, etc.
items.translation: OllamaEmbeddingOptions.java 提供了 Ollama 的配置选项，例如要使用的模型、底层 GPU 和 CPU 调优等。

items.source: The default options can be configured using the spring.ai.ollama.embedding properties as well.
items.translation: 默认选项也可以通过 `spring.ai.ollama.embedding` 属性进行配置。

items.source: The OllamaEmbeddingOptions provides the configuration information for all embedding requests.
items.translation: OllamaEmbeddingOptions 提供了所有嵌入请求的配置信息。

items.source: You first need access to an Ollama instance. There are a few options, including the following:
items.translation: 您首先需要访问一个 Ollama 实例。有几种选择，包括以下：

items.source: Base URL where Ollama API server is running.
items.translation: Ollama API 服务器运行的基础 URL。

items.source: Whether to pull models at startup-time and how.
items.translation: 启动时是否拉取模型以及如何操作。

items.source: How long to wait for a model to be pulled.
items.translation: 等待模型拉取需要多长时间。

items.source: Maximum number of retries for the model pull operation.
items.translation: 模型拉取操作的最大重试次数。

items.source: Include this type of models in the initialization task.
items.translation: 将该类模型纳入初始化任务中。

items.source: Additional models to initialize besides the ones configured via default properties.
items.translation: 除通过默认属性配置的模型外，可初始化的其他模型。

items.source: To enable, spring.ai.model.embedding=ollama (It is enabled by default)
items.translation: 要启用该功能，请设置 spring.ai.model.embedding=ollama（默认已启用）。

items.source: To disable, spring.ai.model.embedding=none (or any value which doesn’t match ollama)
items.translation: 要禁用该功能，请将 spring.ai.model.embedding 设置为 none（或任何与 ollama 不匹配的值）。

items.source: This change is done to allow configuration of multiple models.
items.translation: 此更改旨在支持配置多个模型。

items.source: Here are the advanced request parameter for the Ollama embedding model:
items.translation: 以下是 Ollama 嵌入模型的进阶请求参数：

items.source: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.enabled (Removed and no longer valid)
items.translation: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.enabled（已移除且不再有效）

items.source: Controls how long the model will stay loaded into memory following the request
items.translation: 控制模型在请求之后保留在内存中的时长。

items.source: Truncates the end of each input to fit within context length. Returns error if false and context length is exceeded.
items.translation: 将每个输入的末尾截断以适配上下文长度。若为假且超出上下文长度，则返回错误。

items.source: Whether to use NUMA.
items.translation: 是否使用 NUMA。

items.source: Sets the size of the context window used to generate the next token.
items.translation: 设置用于生成下一个 token 的上下文窗口大小。

items.source: Prompt processing maximum batch size.
items.translation: 提示处理最大批次大小。

items.source: The number of layers to send to the GPU(s). On macOS it defaults to 1 to enable metal support, 0 to disable. 1 here indicates that NumGPU should be set dynamically
items.translation: 要发送到 GPU 的层数。在 macOS 上，默认值为 1 以启用 Metal 支持，为 0 则禁用。此处的 1 表示应动态设置 NumGPU。

items.source: When using multiple GPUs this option controls which GPU is used for small tensors for which the overhead of splitting the computation across all GPUs is not worthwhile. The GPU in question will use slightly more VRAM to store a scratch buffer for temporary results.
items.translation: 在使用多个 GPU 时，此选项控制哪个 GPU 用于处理小张量。对于这类小张量，将计算拆分到所有 GPU 上的开销并不划算。相关的 GPU 会使用稍多的显存来存储临时结果的缓冲区。

items.source: Return logits for all the tokens, not just the last one. To enable completions to return logprobs, this must be true.
items.translation: 返回所有 token 的 logits，而不仅仅是最后一个。若要使补全功能能够返回对数概率，此选项必须为真。

items.source: Load only the vocabulary, not the weights.
items.translation: 仅加载词汇，不加载权重。

items.source: By default, models are mapped into memory, which allows the system to load only the necessary parts of the model as needed. However, if the model is larger than your total amount of RAM or if your system is low on available memory, using mmap might increase the risk of pageouts, negatively impacting performance. Disabling mmap results in slower load times but may reduce pageouts if you’re not using mlock. Note that if the model is larger than the total amount of RAM, turning off mmap would prevent the model from loading at all.
items.translation: 默认情况下，模型会被映射到内存中，这使得系统能够按需加载模型的必要部分。然而，如果模型大小超过您的总内存容量，或者系统可用内存不足，使用 mmap 可能会增加页面换出的风险，从而对性能产生负面影响。禁用 mmap 会导致加载速度变慢，但如果您未使用 mlock，这可能会减少页面换出。请注意，如果模型大小超过总内存容量，关闭 mmap 将导致模型无法加载。

items.source: Lock the model in memory, preventing it from being swapped out when memory-mapped. This can improve performance but trades away some of the advantages of memory-mapping by requiring more RAM to run and potentially slowing down load times as the model loads into RAM.
items.translation: 将模型锁定在内存中，防止其在内存映射时被换出。这可以提升性能，但会牺牲部分内存映射的优势，因为需要占用更多 RAM 来运行，并且可能导致加载时间变长，因为模型需要加载到 RAM 中。

items.source: Sets the number of threads to use during computation. By default, Ollama will detect this for optimal performance. It is recommended to set this value to the number of physical CPU cores your system has (as opposed to the logical number of cores). 0 = let the runtime decide
items.translation: 设置计算时使用的线程数。默认情况下，Ollama 会自动检测以获得最佳性能。建议将此值设置为系统的物理 CPU 核心数（而非逻辑核心数）。0 = 由运行时决定。

items.source: Sets the random number seed to use for generation. Setting this to a specific number will make the model generate the same text for the same prompt.
items.translation: 设置用于生成的随机数种子。将此值设置为特定数字，将使模型对相同的提示生成相同的文本。

items.source: Maximum number of tokens to predict when generating text. (-1 = infinite generation, -2 = fill context)
items.translation: 生成文本时预测的最大 token 数量。（-1 表示无限生成，-2 表示填充上下文）

items.source: Reduces the probability of generating nonsense. A higher value (e.g., 100) will give more diverse answers, while a lower value (e.g., 10) will be more conservative.
items.translation: 降低生成无意义内容的概率。较高的值（例如 100）会提供更多样化的回答，而较低的值（例如 10）则更为保守。

items.source: Works together with top-k. A higher value (e.g., 0.95) will lead to more diverse text, while a lower value (e.g., 0.5) will generate more focused and conservative text.
items.translation: 与 top-k 配合使用。较高的值（例如 0.95）将生成更多样化的文本，而较低的值（例如 0.5）将生成更专注和保守的文本。

items.source: Alternative to the top_p, and aims to ensure a balance of quality and variety. The parameter p represents the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token. For example, with p=0.05 and the most likely token having a probability of 0.9, logits with a value less than 0.045 are filtered out.
items.translation: top_p 的替代方案，旨在确保质量与多样性的平衡。参数 p 表示相对于最可能 token 的概率，一个 token 被考虑所需的最小概率阈值。例如，当 p=0.05 且最可能 token 的概率为 0.9 时，logits 值低于 0.045 的 token 将被过滤掉。

items.source: Tail-free sampling is used to reduce the impact of less probable tokens from the output. A higher value (e.g., 2.0) will reduce the impact more, while a value of 1.0 disables this setting.
items.translation: 无尾采样用于降低输出中低概率 token 的影响。较高的值（例如 2.0）将更显著地降低其影响，而值为 1.0 则禁用此设置。

items.source: Sets how far back for the model to look back to prevent repetition. (Default: 64, 0 = disabled, -1 = num_ctx)
items.translation: 设置模型回溯多远以防止重复。（默认值：64，0 表示禁用，-1 表示 num_ctx）

items.source: The temperature of the model. Increasing the temperature will make the model answer more creatively.
items.translation: 模型的采样温度。提高温度会使模型的回答更具创造性。

items.source: Sets how strongly to penalize repetitions. A higher value (e.g., 1.5) will penalize repetitions more strongly, while a lower value (e.g., 0.9) will be more lenient.
items.translation: 设置对重复项的惩罚强度。较高的值（例如 1.5）会更强地惩罚重复项，而较低的值（例如 0.9）则更为宽松。

items.source: Enable Mirostat sampling for controlling perplexity. (default: 0, 0 = disabled, 1 = Mirostat, 2 = Mirostat 2.0)
items.translation: 启用 Mirostat 采样以控制困惑度。（默认值：0，0=禁用，1=Mirostat，2=Mirostat 2.0）

items.source: Controls the balance between coherence and diversity of the output. A lower value will result in more focused and coherent text.
items.translation: 控制输出的一致性和多样性之间的平衡。较低的数值将产生更加聚焦和连贯的文本。

items.source: Influences how quickly the algorithm responds to feedback from the generated text. A lower learning rate will result in slower adjustments, while a higher learning rate will make the algorithm more responsive.
items.translation: 学习率影响算法对生成文本反馈的响应速度。较低的学习率会导致调整变慢，而较高的学习率则会使算法更加灵敏。

items.source: Sets the stop sequences to use. When this pattern is encountered the LLM will stop generating text and return. Multiple stop patterns may be set by specifying multiple separate stop parameters in a modelfile.
items.translation: 设置要使用的停止序列。当遇到此模式时，LLM 将停止生成文本并返回。可以通过在模型文件中指定多个独立的 stop 参数来设置多个停止模式。

items.source: List of functions, identified by their names, to enable for function calling in a single prompt requests. Functions with those names must exist in the toolCallbacks registry.
items.translation: 启用单提示词请求中函数调用的函数名称列表。这些名称对应的函数必须存在于工具回调（toolCallbacks）注册表中。

items.source:
Spring AI Ollama can automatically pull models when they are not available in your Ollama instance.
This feature is particularly useful for development and testing as well as for deploying your applications to new environments.
items.translation: Spring AI Ollama 可在您的 Ollama 实例中找不到模型时自动拉取模型。此功能对于开发和测试以及将应用程序部署到新环境尤其有用。

items.translation: 拉取模型有三种策略：

items.translation: 您可以在启动时初始化额外的模型，这对于在运行时动态使用的模型非常有用：

items.source: If you want to apply the pulling strategy only to specific types of models, you can exclude embedding models from the initialization task:
items.translation: 如果您只想将拉取策略应用于特定类型的模型，可以在初始化任务中排除嵌入模型：

items.source: This configuration will apply the pulling strategy to all models except embedding models.
items.translation: 此配置将对除嵌入模型之外的所有模型应用拉取策略。
